bio_html: I am a physician with 10+ years of experience in Bangladesh's public health sector, specializing in antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance, infection prevention and control, and health information systems. I led COVID-19 response activities for over 150,000 citizens and have conducted AMR stewardship research presented at international conferences. I am preparing to pursue a Master's in Health Economics, Policy and Management at Karolinska Institutet, with the goal of scaling district-level AMR governance frameworks across Bangladesh's public health system.
